theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 21 群

items.colloc: in relation to 與...有關 | public relations 公共關係
items.distinct: relationship 人際關係 | connection 連結
ex: The company values its relation with clients.
公司重視與客戶的關係。
We discussed plans in relation to the merger.
我們討論了關於合併案的計畫。
Good public relations are vital for growth.
良好的公關對成長至關重要。

items.pos: adj. 負責任的；承擔責任的
ex: Who is responsible for this department?
誰負責這個部門？
The manager is responsible for the budget.
經理負責該項預算。
You are responsible for completing the task.
你有責任完成這項任務。
items.colloc: be responsible for 對...負責 | socially responsible 具社會責任的
items.distinct: accountable 負有解釋責任的 | liable 有法律責任的

items.colloc: safety regulations 安全規定 | workplace safety 工作場所安全
items.distinct: security 保全；防衛 | protection 保護
ex: We prioritize safety in our factory.
我們在工廠內將安全放在首位。
All staff must follow safety protocols.
所有員工必須遵守安全規範。
Regular inspections ensure the safety of equipment.
定期檢查確保了設備的安全。

items.colloc: highly skilled 高度熟練的 | skilled worker 技術工人
items.distinct: qualified 有資格的 | experienced 有經驗的
ex: The firm hires only skilled professionals.
該公司只聘用熟練的專業人士。
She is a highly skilled graphic designer.
她是一位技術高超的平面設計師。
Finding skilled labor is a top priority.
尋找熟練勞動力是首要任務。

items.pos: adj. 至關重要的；充滿活力的
items.zh: 至關重要的；不可或缺的
items.colloc: vital role 至關重要的角色 | vital information 關鍵資訊
items.distinct: crucial 決定性的 | essential 必要的
ex: Marketing plays a vital role in sales.
行銷在銷售中扮演關鍵角色。
Reliable data is vital for decision making.
可靠的數據對於決策至關重要。
This meeting is vital to our success.
這場會議對於我們的成功極其重要。

items.pos: n. 波浪；揮手 | v. 揮動；波動
items.colloc: wave of enthusiasm 熱情高漲 | wave goodbye 揮手道別
items.distinct: fluctuation 波動（數據） | vibration 震動
ex: The new policy caused a wave of concern.
新政策引起了一陣憂慮。
He waved to his colleagues at the exit.
他在出口處向同事揮手。
Economic indicators show a wave of growth.
經濟指標顯示出一波成長。

items.colloc: accept an offer 接受報價 | accept responsibility 承擔責任
items.distinct: admit 承認（錯誤） | receive 收到
ex: We are happy to accept your proposal.
我們很高興接受您的提案。
They accepted the terms of the contract.
他們接受了合約條款。
Does the store accept credit card payments?
這家店接受信用卡付款嗎？

items.colloc: competitive advantage 競爭優勢 | take advantage of 利用
items.distinct: merit 優點 | benefit 利益
ex: Our location gives us a competitive advantage.
我們的地理位置提供了競爭優勢。
Consider all the advantages of this plan.
考慮這項計畫的所有好處。
He took advantage of the free training.
他利用了免費的培訓機會。

items.colloc: advise against 勸阻 | be advised to 建議要...
items.distinct: suggest 建議（非正式） | notify 通知
ex: The consultant advised us to cut costs.
顧問建議我們削減成本。
We advise all passengers to arrive early.
我們建議所有乘客提早抵達。
You are advised to check the itinerary.
建議您確認行程。

items.pos: n. 數量；總額 | v. 總計
items.colloc: a large amount of 大量的 | total amount 總計
items.distinct: quantity 數量（可計算） | number 數字
ex: A large amount of money was spent.
花費了大量的金錢。
The total amount due is five hundred dollars.
應付總金額是五百美元。
These costs amount to our entire budget.
這些費用總計為我們的全部預算。

items.colloc: apologize for 為...道歉 | apologize to 向...道歉
items.distinct: regret 後悔；遺憾 | excuse 原諒
ex: I would like to apologize for the delay.
我想為延誤道歉。
The manager apologized to the angry customer.
經理向憤怒的客戶道歉。
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
我們對造成的不便深表歉意。

items.colloc: approximately equal to 大約等於 | approximately ten percent 大約百分之十
items.distinct: about 大約（口語） | roughly 大略地
ex: The project will take approximately two weeks.
該專案將耗時大約兩週。
Approximately fifty staff members attended the event.
大約有五十名員工參加了活動。
Revenue increased by approximately twenty percent.
營收成長了大約百分之二十。

items.colloc: positive attitude 正面態度 | attitude toward 對...的態度
items.distinct: opinion 看法 | mindset 思維模式
ex: A positive attitude helps in team work.
積極的態度有助於團隊合作。
His attitude toward the project has changed.
他對這個專案的態度改變了。
We value employees with a professional attitude.
我們重視態度專業的員工。

items.pos: n. 獎項；獎金 | v. 授予；判給
items.colloc: win an award 贏得獎項 | award a contract 授予合約
items.distinct: reward 報答；酬謝 | prize 獎品
ex: She won an award for excellent performance.
她因卓越表現贏得了一個獎項。
The company awarded him a bonus check.
公司授予他一張獎金支票。
They were awarded the contract last month.
他們上個月獲得了該合約。

items.pos: v. 禁止 | n. 禁令
items.colloc: impose a ban 實施禁令 | smoking ban 禁菸令
items.distinct: forbid 禁止（正式） | prohibit 法律禁止
ex: The city decided to ban plastic bags.
市府決定禁止使用塑膠袋。
There is a total ban on cell phones.
這裡全面禁止使用手機。
The new regulation bans parking on streets.
新規定禁止在街上停車。

items.colloc: capable of doing 能夠做某事 | highly capable 高度勝任的
items.distinct: competent 勝任的 | able 有能力的
ex: He is capable of handling complex tasks.
他有能力處理複雜的任務。
She is a very capable project manager.
她是一位非常有能力的專案經理。
The system is capable of high performance.
該系統具備高性能的能力。

items.colloc: take a chance 冒險 | have a chance to 有機會做...
items.distinct: opportunity 機會（正式） | possibility 可能性
ex: I had a chance to visit the branch.
我有機會去造訪分公司。
There is a good chance for promotion here.
這裡有很好的升遷機會。
Don't miss the chance to meet them.
別錯過與他們會面的機會。

items.colloc: combine A with B 將 A 與 B 結合 | combine forces 聯手
items.distinct: merge 合併（企業） | unite 團結
ex: We should combine our resources for success.
我們應該結合資源以取得成功。
The software combines speed with simplicity.
這套軟體結合了速度與簡潔。
They combined two departments into one unit.
他們將兩個部門合併成一個單位。

items.colloc: comfortable chair 舒適的椅子 | feel comfortable with 對...感到自在
items.distinct: cozy 溫馨舒適的 | relaxing 放鬆的
ex: The new office chairs are very comfortable.
新的辦公椅非常舒適。
I feel comfortable with this new arrangement.
對於這個新安排我感到自在。
Make yourself comfortable in the waiting area.
請在休息區自在地就座。

items.pos: v. 承諾；投入（時間或金錢）
items.colloc: commit to doing 承諾做某事 | commit resources 投入資源
items.distinct: dedicate 致力於 | pledge 保證
ex: We commit to providing the best service.
我們承諾提供最好的服務。
They committed all resources to the project.
他們將所有資源投入到該專案。
Both parties committed to a long-term goal.
雙方都承諾致力於長期目標。
